about: Storms in the runtimes themselves, which the package advisory databases don't cover. Add an entry when a big one breaks.

runtime.says: lets anyone run code on the server, with no login and no bug in your own code
runtime.backports: Debian, Ubuntu and Red Hat ship the fix without changing the version number: check the package changelog for CVE-2026-109618.
runtime.restart: restart every PHP worker (PHP-FPM, Apache, queue workers) after updating
